transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess what brings me in is... I just can't shake this feeling that I've ruined things for everyone. I've been falling behind at work, and I kind of lost control of the whole apartment situation. It just feels like... like I deserve whatever bad thing happens to me next.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It's been about a year and two months now. It started right after a pipe burst in my old place. I had to move into this much smaller apartment, and... I don't know, my whole routine just fell apart after that. I haven't been able to get back on track since.
Do you still find pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy?

Not really. Most days I just wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. The things that used to kind of reset me... like putting on a record, cooking, or tinkering with electronics... they just don't reach me anymore. I don't really get anything out of them now.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

No, not really. Like I was just saying, there isn't much of anything right now. Most days I just wake up with that flat, heavy sadness I mentioned. I still try to do the things that used to reset my brain—you know, putting on a record, cooking, or tinkering with my electronics—but they just don't reach me anymore. I don't really get any enjoyment out of them at all.
Have you had periods in your life where you felt significantly better than you do now, without this heavy sadness?

Yeah, definitely. Before the move, before all this started, I felt fine. I didn't have this heavy sadness. And... well, I never had those voices, or that fixed fear about being watched at work, before the depression set in. All of that really only shows up during these same bad stretches—when I'm feeling really low, guilty, and just worn down. When I'm actually doing okay, or back when I was doing okay, I didn't experience any of that.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt this heavy sadness?
No, this is... this is really the first time. Before this whole stretch started, I was always pretty steady. I've never gone through a period like this before where I felt this down.
Have you had any periods of significant improvement in your mood since this heavy sadness started, where you felt back to your normal self for a while?

No, there really hasn't been any break in it. It's just been a constant thing... for about a year and two months now. It all started when a pipe burst at my old place and I had to move into this much smaller apartment. All my normal routines just kind of fell apart after that, and I haven't felt like my normal self since.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in activities you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I really have. Most days I just wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. It's like... the things that used to reset me, you know? Putting on a record, cooking a decent meal, tinkering with electronics... they just don't reach me anymore. I don't really have the drive to do any of it.
Have you had any other episodes of depression like this one before in your life?
No, like I mentioned earlier, this is really the first time. I've never gone through anything like this before.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months where you didn't feel this heavy sadness?
No, I really haven't. Like I said, it's just been constant since the move... so for over a year now, there hasn't been a break like that at all. Just the same heavy feeling every day.
Have you had any earlier episodes of depression that lasted for less than two months before this current one started?
No, no earlier episodes. This whole thing just started after the move, and I've never felt anything like this before then. So, no short episodes or anything like that in the past.
Have you ever had an episode of depression that lasted for at least two weeks before this current one started?

No, I haven't. Like I was saying, this is the first time I've ever dealt with anything like this. Before the move, I was fine. There weren't any two-week periods of feeling like this, or anything close to it, before all this started.
Have you had any periods where you felt completely back to normal for at least two months since this depression started?

No, definitely not. It's just been a steady downward slide since we relocated. I haven't had a single day where I felt like my old self, let alone two whole months. It's just been this constant weight the entire time.
Have you ever had an episode of depression that lasted less than two weeks before this current one started?

No, not even for a few days. I... I really haven't had any periods of feeling like this before we relocated. This is the very first time I've ever dealt with this, regardless of how short or long it lasted. So, no, nothing at all before this current situation started.
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that met the same criteria as your current feelings?

No, I really haven't. Like I've been saying, this whole experience is completely new to me. I've never felt this way before, not even once, until we moved. There haven't been any other episodes at all.
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that lasted at least two weeks?

No, nothing like that. I know we're kind of covering the same ground, but... yeah, I've never had any period of depression that lasted two weeks before this. Or any amount of time, really. It's just been this one time, ever since the move.
Have you had any episodes of depression before this one that were separated from this one by a period of at least two months where you felt completely back to normal?

No, I haven't. Like I mentioned, I haven't had any depression before this current episode at all. So there wasn't anything to recover from or have a normal period after. This is really the only time I've gone through this.
Have you had any periods of full recovery from this depression, where you felt completely back to normal, before feeling this way again?

No, I haven't. It's, uh... it's just been continuous. Ever since this started after the move, it hasn't gone away at all. So there haven't been any breaks where I felt like my normal self again. It's just been this one long stretch.
Have you had any periods where this heavy sadness went away for at least two months before coming back?
No, I haven't. Um... I know we keep kind of circling the same timeline here, but no. It hasn't gone away for two months, or even a few days really. It's just been constant since it started.
Have you had any periods where you felt completely back to normal for at least two months since your last episode of depression before this current one?

I think we might be getting our wires crossed a bit. Like I mentioned earlier, I didn't have a previous episode before this current one. This is the very first time I've ever dealt with anything like this. So, no, there wasn't any time to recover from a past episode, because there simply wasn't one.
